aircraft_registration: Polish aircraft registration: SP- and three letters, like `SP-ABC`, SP-S or SP-X and three letters for ultralights and autogyros, or four digits for gliders, like `SP-3456`.
bic: BIC (SWIFT code) of a Polish bank: four letters, PL and two letters or digits, with an optional three-character branch code, like `PKOPPLPW` or `BREXPLPWXXX`.
company_name: Polish company name (nazwa firmy): capitalized words followed by a legal form such as Sp. z o.o., sp.k., sp.j., S.A., S.K.A. or P.S.A., or spółka ... written out, like `Nowak sp.j.`.
iban: Polish IBAN: PL, two check digits and 24 digits, together or in groups of four, like `PL61 1090 1014 0000 0712 1981 2874`.
iccid: SIM card number (ICCID) of a Polish SIM: 8948 followed by 14 to 16 digits, without spaces, like `8948021234567890126`.
id_card_number: Polish identity card number (numer dowodu osobistego): three letters and six digits, with or without a space, like `ABA300000` or `ZZC 108201`.
imsi: IMSI (subscriber identity on a SIM) of a Polish network: mobile country code 260 and 12 more digits, 15 in all, like `260021234567890`.
krs_number: Polish National Court Register number (numer KRS, Krajowy Rejestr Sądowy) after the keyword KRS, keyword included: ten digits, like `KRS 0000123456`.
license_plate: Polish license plate (tablica rejestracyjna): a district code of two or three letters and a serial of digits and letters in the official patterns, like `WA 12345`, `KR 1234A` or `KRA 1C34`.
mobile_number: Polish mobile number (numer komórkowy): nine digits with a mobile prefix, with +48 or 0048, or with spaces or dashes like `600 123 456`; only valid Polish mobile numbers.
mrz_id_card: Machine-readable zone (MRZ) of a Polish identity card, first line (ICAO TD1): 30 characters with POL as issuing country, like `IDPOLZZC1082012<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<`.
mrz_passport: Machine-readable zone (MRZ) of a Polish passport, second line (ICAO TD3): 44 characters with the passport number, POL as nationality, date of birth, sex and expiry date.
msisdn: Polish mobile number in MSISDN form, as in telecom records: 48 and the nine-digit mobile number, like `48600123456`; only valid Polish mobile numbers.
nip: Polish tax identification number (NIP, numer identyfikacji podatkowej): ten digits after NIP, keyword included, or on their own with dashes, like `123-456-32-18` or `123-45-63-218`.
nrb: Polish bank account number (NRB, numer rachunku bankowego): 26 digits, the IBAN without PL, together or grouped like `61 1090 1014 0000 0712 1981 2874`.
passport_number: Polish passport number (numer paszportu): two letters and seven digits, with or without a space, like `ZZ3000001`.
pesel: Polish national identification number (PESEL): 11 digits starting with the birth date, like `01451401354`; only real dates of birth.
phone_number: Polish phone number (numer telefonu): +48 or 0048 and nine digits, landlines with a real area code like `(22) 123 45 67`, and mobiles like `600 123 456`; only valid Polish numbers.
postal_code_city: Polish postal code (kod pocztowy) and town: two digits, a dash and three digits, then the place name, like `00-950 Warszawa` or `43-300 Bielsko-Biała`.
regon: Polish business register number (REGON) after the keyword REGON, keyword included: nine or 14 digits, like `REGON: 123456785` or `REGON 12345678512347`.
street_address: Polish street address (adres): ul., al., pl. or os. (or ulica, aleja, plac, osiedle), the name and number, with the flat after a slash, m. or lok., like `ul. Jana Pawła II 12/34`.
vat_number: Polish VAT number (NIP UE): PL and the ten-digit NIP, together or with dashes, like `PL1234563218` or `PL 123-456-32-18`.
